cn.t: This clever meta-theatrical mash-up of Chekhov's "The Seagull" with director Molochnikov's real experience staging the play amid Russia's Ukraine invasion earns modest praise for its inventive concept, though execution doesn't fully match ambition.

vr.q: I found this to be a rare case where a show throws in everything but the kitchen sink, and it still works.
The theatrical inventiveness is genuinely impressive... the story itself is genuinely engaging and timely.
